body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 39222a595081c7fb8181f782e510494d40ceb483 -->
**Read-only review (no worktree, no build, no cargo run).** Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- The one sentence is byte-identical in `.claude/skills/work-issue/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md`, `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md` and `.claude/agents/gate-runner.md`. It matches #935: prefer `cargo xtask gate`, `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache` only when sccache is on PATH, never export `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`. Nothing else in those files was rewritten, and it does not conflict with the neighbouring rules (the existing "no CARGO_TARGET_DIR" lines say the same thing).
- AGENTS.md "Build cache" paragraph carries the same rule in one sentence and adds that `cargo xtask release` clears any wrapper for packaging. Accurate against the code.
- `exec::packaging_env_clear` returns the names of the wrapper variables that are set, and `release.rs` `run_clearing` calls `Command::env_remove` for each. So both `RUSTC_WRAPPER` and `CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER` are removed from the child environment, not set to empty. `build()` is the only packaging path and is the one that changed; the gate tier still goes through `run` with the cache env.
- `cache_env` collapse (`if let Some(path) = sccache && !wrapper_set && !opted_out`): same four inputs, same outputs as before. The existing `cache_env` unit test (tests.rs, the wrapper/opt-out/size cases) still covers every branch.
- The new unit test pins both-set, only-`CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER`-set, and none-set. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in the new code. Edition 2024 workspace, so the let-chain is valid.
- `.cargo/config.toml`, `.claude/settings.json` and `.github/` are not touched (checked against the PR head). No trigger added.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 15 on origin/main (bac4d015) and 16 on the head. The AGENTS.md change and the skill/agent changes are process files, so the bump is correct.
- PR body: what changed, tests (`cargo test -p xtask` 33 passed, clippy clean, as the author reports), `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #935`. It names what a fork must do (pull the process files).

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (non-blocking)
1. The packaging build clears only the environment variables. A `build.rustc-wrapper` set in a user's `~/.cargo/config.toml` would still apply to `cargo xtask release`. #935 asked for the env-var fix, so this is only a remark; if the shipped-binary guarantee should be absolute, a `--config build.rustc-wrapper=""` argument would cover it later.
2. The unit test does not pin the case where only `RUSTC_WRAPPER` is set. The helper is generic, so the code path is covered, but one more assert would make the test read the same as the issue.
3. The AGENTS.md edit is one very long line in the existing paragraph. Wrapping it would keep the diff readable. Cosmetic.
4. origin/main has moved since this PR's base (`crates/cl/tests/headless_bin.rs` differs). That is main's change, not this PR's; the PR is still MERGEABLE.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
